description: Source code for cellular web configuration API, including functions for managing subdoc versions, registering subdocs, applying cellular configuration, processing web config requests, and resource cleanup.

methods.name: getBlobVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the version number of a specified subdocument from configuration storage.

methods.name: setBlobVersion
methods.description: Updates the version number of a specified subdocument in configuration storage.

methods.name: webConfigFrameworkInit
methods.description: Initializes the web configuration framework by registering supported subdocuments and their version callbacks.

methods.name: set_cell_conf
methods.description: Applies cellular configuration parameters from a given document.

methods.name: Process_Cellularmgr_WebConfigRequest
methods.description: Handles incoming cellular web configuration requests, executes configuration, and returns status.

methods.name: freeResources_CELL
methods.description: Frees resources allocated during cellular configuration processing.
